title: Guterres calls on countries to set clear timelines for transition away from fossil fuels
content:
“We are the first generation with the tools to end the fossil fuel age – and the last who can avert climate catastrophe,” UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Wednesday, calling on countries to draw up credible roadmaps with clear timelines to transition away from fossil fuels. Read Full Story on UN News

title: How El Niño offers a test of whether the world can adapt to a changing climate
content:
El Niño is strengthening in a world that is already hotter, raising the risk of drought, floods and crop losses across some of the world’s most important food-producing regions. title: Why climate action now comes down to speed, finance and cooperation
content:
Temporarily exceeding the 1.5°C global warming goal set in Paris is widely considered inevitable. The challenge now is to keep that overshoot as small and short as possible by cutting emissions faster, unlocking finance and strengthening international cooperation. Read Full Story on UN News

title: In Tanzania, the sea is moving inland – and taking livelihoods with it
content:
Along the coast of Tanzania, in East Africa, the Indian Ocean is pushing saltwater ever farther inland, shrinking coconut harvests, driving fish away and leaving some residents wondering how much longer they can stay. Read Full Story on UN News
